ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
    Radial/Polar Movement Control Script - Enhanced
]]

-- CONFIGURATION
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The maximum distance (in inches/units) the model can move from its starting point
local MAX_RANGE = 10

-- The maximum angle (in degrees) the model can rotate left or right from its starting facing
local MAX_TURN_ANGLE = 45

-- The distance (in inches) the cursor must move from the center before the model 
-- reacts. This prevents unwanted rotation/movement on initial pickup. 
-- This is very important for preventing a janky feeling
local MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD = 0.1

-- Controls how quickly the model catches up to the cursor (Smoothing). 
-- Higher values = Snappier, Lower values = Smoother/Slower.
local SMOOTH_SPEED = 6

-- The radius of the circular scan range (in inches)
local SCAN_RADIUS = 8
-- The radius of the signature (in inches)
local SIGNATURE_RADIUS_BASE = 10
local SIGNATURE_RADIUS_STEP = 3

-- Set to true if your model geometry faces its local X-axis (Red arrow).
-- Set to false if it faces its local Z-axis (Blue arrow).
local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true

-- Visual Debug lines (optional, set to false to disable)
local DRAW_RAIL_LINE = true

-- Scale correction factor (2.0 corrects for 10 units = 5 inches mismatch)
local UNIT_SCALE = 2.0

-- Vertical offset for lines to prevent Z-fighting
local LINE_Y_OFFSET = 0.3
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local isHeld = false
local holdingPlayerColor = nil
local showFiringArcs = false
local showScan = false
local showSignature = false

local cachedFiringArcLines = nil
local cachedScanLines = nil
local cachedSignatureLines = nil

local currentSignatureRadius = SIGNATURE_RADIUS_BASE

-- State variables
local pivotPosition = nil
local startRotation = nil
local startForwardVec = nil
local currentSmoothedPos = nil

function onLoad()
    -- Ensure buttons are clear on load
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtons()
    
    -- Pre-calculate firing arc lines so we don't do it every frame
    generateFiringArcLines()
    generateScanLines()
    generateSignatureLines()
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}
    
    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end
    
    local arcLineColor = {1, 1, 1}       -- White
    
    -- Helper to add symmetric lines
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)
        
        -- Line 1 (Right side) - 60 inches total centered (30 each way)
        local p1 = rotRight * (30 * UNIT_SCALE)
        local p2 = rotRight * (-30 * UNIT_SCALE)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        
        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = arcLineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
        
        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * (30 * UNIT_SCALE)
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-30 * UNIT_SCALE)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        
        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = arcLineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end
    
    -- Front/Side/Rear
    addAngleLines(45)
    -- Front/Rear Narrow
    addAngleLines(11)
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green
    
    -- Circle Scan Range
    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * SCAN_RADIUS * UNIT_SCALE
        local z = math.sin(angle) * SCAN_RADIUS * UNIT_SCALE
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end
    
    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}
    local circleColor = {1, 0.5, 0.5}    -- Light Red
    
    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * currentSignatureRadius * UNIT_SCALE
        local z = math.sin(angle) * currentSignatureRadius * UNIT_SCALE
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end
    
    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end


-- Event: Called when a player picks up the object
function onPickUp(player_color)
    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color
    
    -- Clear any existing Undo button immediately when picked up
    self.clearButtons()
    
    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    -- This serves as both the Pivot Point for movement and the Undo target
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()
    
    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

-- Event: Called when a player drops the object
function onDrop(player_color)
    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil
    
    -- NOTE: We do NOT clear pivotPosition/startRotation here, 
    -- because we need them for the Undo button.
    
    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    
    -- Clear visual debug lines
    if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        self.setVectorLines({})
    end
    
    -- Create the Buttons
    createUndoButton()
    createButtons()
    
    -- If arcs were on, ensure they are redrawn cleanly
    updateStaticVisuals()
end

function createButtons()
    -- Firing Arcs Button
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_toggle_arcs",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Firing Arcs",
        position       = {0, 7, 3},
        width          = 1100,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 150,
        color          = {0, 0, 1},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Toggle firing arc visibility"
    })
    
    -- Scan Button
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_toggle_scan",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Scan",
        position       = {0, 7, 3.6},
        width          = 1100,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 150,
        color          = {0, 0.5, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Toggle scan range visibility"
    })

    -- Signature Row
    -- Main Signature Toggle
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_toggle_signature",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Sig: " .. currentSignatureRadius,
        position       = {0, 7, 4.2},
        width          = 800,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 150,
        color          = {0.8, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Toggle signature visibility"
    })
    
    -- Decrease Signature (-)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_decrease_signature",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "-",
        position       = {-1.5, 7, 4.2},
        width          = 300,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 200,
        color          = {0.5, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Decrease signature"
    })

    -- Increase Signature (+)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_increase_signature",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "+",
        position       = {1.5, 7, 4.2},
        width          = 300,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 200,
        color          = {0.5, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Increase signature"
    })
end

function updateButtons()
    -- Re-create all buttons to update labels (simplest method for TTS Lua)
    if not isHeld then
        self.clearButtons()
        createUndoButton()
        createButtons()
    end
end

function click_toggle_arcs(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    showFiringArcs = not showFiringArcs
    updateStaticVisuals()
end

function click_toggle_scan(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    showScan = not showScan
    updateStaticVisuals()
end

function click_toggle_signature(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    showSignature = not showSignature
    updateStaticVisuals()
end

function click_increase_signature(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    currentSignatureRadius = currentSignatureRadius + SIGNATURE_RADIUS_STEP
    generateSignatureLines()
    updateStaticVisuals()
    updateButtons()
end

function click_decrease_signature(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local newSig = currentSignatureRadius - SIGNATURE_RADIUS_STEP
    if newSig >= SIGNATURE_RADIUS_BASE then
        currentSignatureRadius = newSig
        generateSignatureLines()
        updateStaticVisuals()
        updateButtons()
    end
end

function updateStaticVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}
    
    if showFiringArcs and cachedFiringArcLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end
    
    if showScan and cachedScanLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end
    
    if showSignature and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end
    
    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function createUndoButton()
    -- We want the button to float slightly above the object.
    -- Bounds size is global, so we divide by scale to get local position Y
    local globalHeight = self.getBoundsNormalized().size.y
    local scaleY = self.getScale().y
    
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "click_undo",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Undo Move",
        position       = {0, 7, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 1100,
        height         = 300,
        font_size      = 200,
        color          = {1, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {0, 0, 0},
        tooltip        = "Revert to position before pickup"
    })
end

function click_undo(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if pivotPosition and startRotation then
        self.setPositionSmooth(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotationSmooth(startRotation)
        
        -- After undoing, we remove the button since we are back at start
        self.clearButtons()
        createButtons() -- Re-add the arc button as clearButtons wipes it
    end
end

-- Event: Called every frame
function onUpdate()
    -- Only run logic if the object is currently being held
    if isHeld and pivotPosition and holdingPlayerColor then
        local player = Player[holdingPlayerColor]
        
        -- Safety check if player disconnects mid-hold
        if player then
            updateRadialMovement(player)
        else
            -- Force drop if player is gone
            onDrop(nil)
        end
    end
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()
    
    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()
    
    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    -- If we haven't moved far enough, lock to original position/rotation
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        
        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition
        
        -- Clear lines if inside deadzone (but keep arcs if enabled)
        updateStaticVisuals()
        return
    end
    
    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    -- Initial direction towards cursor
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()
    
    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)
    
    -- Check if angle exceeds limit
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE then
        -- Determine if we are to the left or right?
        -- We use Cross Product. Up/Down (Y) tells us the side.
        -- TTS/Unity: Y is up.
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        
        -- Determine the sign of the rotation based on the Y component of the cross product
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        
        -- Override moveDir to the max clamped angle
        -- We take the start vector and rotate it by the max angle in the correct direction
        -- rotateOver modifies self, so we copy() first
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE)
    end
    
    -- 4. Calculate New Position (using clamped direction)
    -- Clamp distance to MAX_RANGE
    local clampDist = math.min(currentDist, MAX_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE)
    
    local targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
    
    -- Preserve the object's current height (controlled by the player's hand lift)
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y
    
    -- Smoothly interpolation towards the target position
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end

    -- Use persistent smoothed position to avoid physics/hand-drag fighting
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    
    -- Keep Y responsive (prevent vertical lag)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y

    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)
    
    -- 5. Calculate Rotation (Face Outwards along the clamped direction)
    -- Get the angle of the valid movement vector
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))
    
    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    
    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add sticky Firing Arcs if enabled (so they move with the ship)
    if showFiringArcs and cachedFiringArcLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end
    
    if showScan and cachedScanLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end
    
    if showSignature and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        -- Calculate visual direction based on actual ship position relative to pivot
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0 
        
        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE)
        
        -- Convert to local for drawing
        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        
        -- Calculate Limit Lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE)
        
        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE)
        
        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })
        
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })
        
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })
    end
    
    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end
